description: React component for managing an Assistant dialog, including creating, editing, syncing, and deleting assistants with support for file uploads, vector store management, and various assistant configurations.

methods.name: syncData
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with assistant data object.

methods.name: onEditAssistantVectorStoreClick
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit a vector store object.

methods.name: onAddAssistantVectorStoreClick
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new vector store.

methods.name: addNewAssistant
methods.description: Creates a new assistant via API and handles success/error.

methods.name: saveAssistant
methods.description: Saves updates to an existing assistant via API.

methods.name: uploadFormDataToVectorStore
methods.description: Uploads files to vector store and updates state.

methods.name: uploadFormDataToCodeInterpreter
methods.description: Uploads files to code interpreter tool and updates state.

methods.name: detachVectorStore
methods.description: Removes vector store association from tool resources.

methods.name: onDeleteClick
methods.description: Prepares and opens delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: deleteAssistant
methods.description: Deletes assistant via API, handles success/error.

methods.name: onFileDeleteClick
methods.description: Removes a file from tool resources and deletes from vector store if applicable.
